key_insight: QSim-Arena uses AI agents to make quantum simulation advantage assessment an evolving, reproducible process rather than a fixed comparison.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps engineers compare quantum resource requirements against independently crosschecked classical baselines as algorithms and hardware evolve.
method: Specify Hamiltonians, initial states and accuracy targets for evolved states or observables.
Translate published methods into executable components, reproduce results and benchmark competing classical techniques.
Explore recombined classical methods and co-design fault-tolerant quantum circuits using literature-derived knowledge.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved baseline resource estimates in initial applications through established techniques, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: The framework does not establish practical quantum advantage; conclusions depend on validated implementations, error bounds and hardware assumptions.
paper_title: QSim-Arena: an evolving developer for quantum simulation advantage
